thermometer.name: Thermometer
thermometer.description: Measures the boiling point temperature of the vapour entering the condenser to identify the pure liquid fraction distilling over.

distillation_flask.name: Round-Bottomed Distillation Flask
distillation_flask.description: Heat-resistant borosilicate glass flask holding the liquid mixture being heated to boiling.

boiling_solution.name: Liquid Mixture / Solution
boiling_solution.description: Homogeneous liquid mixture containing components with different boiling points undergoing selective vaporisation.

tripod_and_gauze.name: Tripod Stand and Wire Gauze
tripod_and_gauze.description: Supports the distillation flask above the flame and distributes heat evenly across the glass base.

bunsen_burner.name: Bunsen Burner (Heat Source)
bunsen_burner.description: Supplies thermal energy to heat the more volatile liquid component to its boiling point so it vaporises.

cooling_water_out.name: Cooling Water Outlet
cooling_water_out.description: Upper outlet where warmed cooling water exits the condenser jacket toward the sink.

liebig_condenser.name: Liebig Condenser
liebig_condenser.description: Double-walled glass tube surrounded by a cold water jacket that cools hot vapour back into liquid state (condensation).

cooling_water_in.name: Cold Water Inlet
cooling_water_in.description: Lower inlet where cold tap water enters at the bottom of the jacket to maintain counter-current cooling and keep the jacket completely full.

receiving_flask.name: Conical Receiving Flask
receiving_flask.description: Clean vessel positioned at the condenser outlet to collect the condensed pure liquid.

purified_distillate.name: Purified Distillate (Pure Water)
purified_distillate.description: The purified liquid collected after vaporisation and condensation.
